notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.3 Distribution
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles."
We have released an update patch to the game.
The details of the update are as follows:

■ Update ver.1.0.3
Fixed the bug that Secret Skill is not activated in quests that require its skill to clear.

Thank you for your continued support of "That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles."
